x: Then they had four home to our three, but Frank Abberton scored 27th to make it four each. But Sutton still had five in before our 5th man (Tom Carter 41st) and then praise be, Tommy Clinton came along in 57th place to complete our scoring six, while Sutton's 6th man finished 65th!
Two former members of winning 'National' C.C. teams have been to our fixtures. On Boxing Day we had DICK TOBIN eyeing the field and FRANK ABBERTON was at the Surrey C.C.

Len Herbert was coming through well and Frank Abberton and Tom Clinton were also well placed. Albert Frost unfortunately had a bad time but Tom Carter was running well and eventually became our sixth scoring man with Les Stokell unluckily missing a winner's medal by two places.
On the next stage to Merstham, Ted Stimpson held his place ... then Frank Abberton tackled the uphill stage through Redhill and ran a fine race to take us up to 2nd place.
